decks.notes: This deck focuses on using a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With Faerie Mastermind and Spyglass Siren providing early threats, the deck aims to control the board with cards like Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse while continuing to apply pressure with Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Floodpits Drowner. In addition, cards like Anoint with Affliction and Go for the Throat help to remove any opposing threats, allowing the deck to maintain its tempo and secure a swift victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to maintain board presence through efficient creature spells like Heartfire Hero and Emberheart Challenger, while using burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Helix to control the board and finish off opponents. The inclusion of cards like Shardmage's Rescue and Sheltered by Ghosts provide protection and resilience for the aggressive creatures. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on opponents and quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's strategy using a combination of control cards and creatures with abilities that hinder their game plan. The goal is to maintain constant pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their resources and options. By playing a mix of disruptive spells, creatures, and lands, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and resilient threat that can quickly close out the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger to quickly build a strong board presence and put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes spells like Burst Lightning and Torch the Tower to deal direct damage to the opponent or remove threats. The inclusion of Snakeskin Veil and Soulstone Sanctuary helps protect and buff our creatures, allowing us to maintain pressure and close out the game quickly. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing low-cost creatures and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The strategy revolves around establishing an early board presence with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while leveraging burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Helix to both control the board and deal damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Sheltered by Ghosts and Shardmage's Rescue provide protection and resilience for key creatures, allowing for continuous pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent, utilizing cheap and efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Hired Claw along with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Monstrous Rage and Witchstalker Frenzy while maintaining a steady stream of damage. It also includes mana-fixing lands like Inspiring Vantage and Battlefield Forge to ensure consistent casting of spells. Overall, the deck focuses on fast-paced aggression to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and reduce their life total to zero. It includes a variety of low-cost creatures that can deal damage quickly, as well as spells that can disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards that can generate card advantage and provide additional resources to keep up the pressure. Overall, the goal is to establish board control early and maintain pressure throughout the game to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly and aggressively dealing damage to the opponent using low-cost, efficient burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning, as well as powerful creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger. The goal is to build a board presence early on and maintain pressure with a steady stream of creatures and direct damage spells. The inclusion of cards like Monstrous Rage and Screaming Nemesis enhances the deck's ability to push through damage and close out games swiftly. The strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By using powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck aims to control the board and push for a fast victory. Faerie Mastermind and Spyglass Siren provide additional disruption and card advantage, while cards like Enduring Curiosity help maintain card advantage throughout the game. The mana base is designed to ensure consistent access to both black and blue mana sources.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board by utilizing a variety of token generators, bounce spells, and removal spells to outvalue the opponent. By generating tokens with cards like Seed of Hope and Tolarian Terror, and utilizing bounce spells like Unsummon and Cache Grab, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while creating card advantage. Additionally, the deck includes card draw with cards like Sleight of Hand and Stormchaser's Talent to maintain resources. Overall, the goal is to control the game and outlast the opponent to secure a victory.

The key strategy is to play multiple low-cost creatures quickly and use combat tricks and burn spells to push through enough damage to win the game before the opponent can stabilize. The mana base includes lands that can enter untapped to ensure a smooth curve of aggression.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Sandstorm Salvager and Skyknight Squire, while disrupting opponents with cards like Get Lost and Sheltered by Ghosts. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggression and efficient creature removal, utilizing cards like Soul Partition and Collector's Cage to protect your creatures. By combining early game pressure with late-game threats like Overlord of the Mistmoors and Sanguine Evangelist, this deck aims to close out games quickly and decisively.

The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of small, efficient creatures that can quickly build up a threatening board presence.
